title: NCCM onboarding validates connectivity from the assigned collector

steps.action: Login as admin; discover a branch device through a branch Collector so it is in Inventory with that Collector assigned, and confirm polling works
steps.expected: Device is monitored successfully through its Collector

steps.action: Onboard that device for NCCM from the Inventory screen
steps.expected: Connectivity validation runs from the assigned Collector and succeeds. Today it runs from the Main/Master server and fails with Ping/Port errors — the reported defect

title: Branch device unreachable from master still onboards for NCCM

steps.action: Set up a device reachable from its branch Collector but NOT from the Main/Master server
steps.expected: Device polls fine via the Collector

steps.action: Onboard it for NCCM
steps.expected: Onboarding completes — reachability from the master is not required when a Collector is assigned

title: Ping check is executed by the assigned collector, not the master

steps.action: Onboard a Collector-assigned device for NCCM while watching where the ping originates
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Inspect the source of the ping
steps.expected: The ping check executes on the assigned Collector. The discovery engine's ping-check routine must be dispatched to the Collector rather than run locally on the master

title: Port check is executed by the assigned collector, not the master

steps.action: Onboard a Collector-assigned device for NCCM whose SSH/Telnet port is reachable only from the Collector
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Inspect the source of the port check
steps.expected: The port check executes on the assigned Collector and reports the port open

title: Device with no collector assigned still validates from the master

steps.action: Onboard a device that has no specific Collector assigned (master-polled)
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Inspect the outcome
steps.expected: Validation runs from the Main/Master server exactly as before — the change must not break the default topology

title: Genuine unreachability from the collector still fails clearly

steps.action: Assign a Collector to a device, then make the device unreachable from that Collector too
steps.expected: Device is down from the Collector

steps.action: Onboard it for NCCM
steps.expected: Onboarding fails with a Ping/Port connectivity error that names the Collector it was attempted from — the fix must not mask real failures

title: Error message identifies which collector performed the check

steps.action: Trigger a failing NCCM connectivity validation on a Collector-assigned device
steps.expected: Validation fails

steps.action: Read the error
steps.expected: It states the Collector used, so an operator can tell a wrong-collector problem from a genuine unreachability

title: Ping check honours the configured timeout and packet count

steps.action: Note the configured ping-check timeout and packet count, then onboard a device that drops ICMP
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Measure the failure
steps.expected: It fails after the configured timeout using the configured packet count — the same configuration values as the existing discovery ping check, applied on the Collector

title: Validation is skipped when ping check is not required

steps.action: Onboard a device of a type/profile where ping check is not required
steps.expected: Onboarding proceeds

steps.action: Inspect the flow
steps.expected: The ping check is skipped per the existing require-check logic rather than being forced and failing

title: Multiple branches each validate through their own collector

steps.action: Assign Collector A to a device in branch A and Collector B to a device in branch B
steps.expected: Both poll successfully

steps.action: Onboard both for NCCM
steps.expected: Each validates from its own Collector; neither is validated from the other branch's Collector or from the master

title: Reassigning a device to another collector changes the validation source

steps.action: Onboard a device for NCCM via Collector A, then reassign it to Collector B
steps.expected: Reassignment saved

steps.action: Re-run NCCM connectivity validation
steps.expected: The check now runs from Collector B without needing to re-onboard the device

title: Collector down during onboarding produces a clear error

steps.action: Stop the assigned Collector, then onboard its device for NCCM
steps.expected: Validation is attempted

steps.action: Read the error
steps.expected: It reports that the assigned Collector is unavailable rather than silently falling back to the master or hanging indefinitely

title: No silent fallback to the master when the collector check fails

steps.action: Make a device reachable from the master but not from its assigned Collector, then onboard it
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Inspect the outcome
steps.expected: Validation fails on the Collector result and does not quietly retry from the master — a silent fallback would reintroduce the bug in reverse and mislead the operator

title: Subsequent NCCM operations also use the assigned collector

steps.action: Onboard a branch device for NCCM through its Collector, then run a configuration backup on it
steps.expected: Operation runs

steps.action: Inspect the operation
steps.expected: Backup connects through the assigned Collector too — onboarding validation and ongoing NCCM operations must agree on the path

title: Monitoring and polling are unaffected by the change

steps.action: Record polling health for a Collector-assigned device before the change
steps.expected: Baseline captured

steps.action: Re-check after onboarding it for NCCM
steps.expected: Polling continues through the same Collector with no gap or duplication

title: Bulk NCCM onboarding from Inventory respects per-device collectors

steps.action: Select devices spanning two different Collectors in Inventory and onboard them for NCCM together
steps.expected: Bulk onboarding runs

steps.action: Inspect each device
steps.expected: Each is validated from its own assigned Collector; a single shared path is not used for the whole selection

title: Credential errors remain distinguishable from connectivity errors

steps.action: Onboard a Collector-reachable device for NCCM with wrong device credentials
steps.expected: Validation runs

steps.action: Read the error
steps.expected: It reports a credential/authentication failure, not a Ping/Port connectivity failure — distinguishable credential errors are an existing documented requirement

title: Audit records which collector performed the validation

steps.action: Onboard a Collector-assigned device for NCCM
steps.expected: Onboarding completes

steps.action: Open the audit trail
steps.expected: The record names the device, the actor and the Collector used for validation

title: HA/failover: validation follows the surviving collector

steps.action: In a deployment with redundant Collectors, fail over the Collector assigned to a device
steps.expected: Failover completes

steps.action: Onboard or re-validate the device for NCCM
steps.expected: Validation runs from the surviving Collector rather than falling back to the master
